db.query.text.value: SELECT e.id, e.title, e.slug, e.date_start::text, e.cover_image_url AS cover_image, e.event_type, v.name AS venue_name, v.city, p.name AS promoter_name, e.currency, (SELECT MIN(tt.base_price) FROM catalog.ticket_types tt WHERE tt.event_id = e.id AND tt.visibility <> ?) AS min_price, e.category, e.subcategory FROM catalog.events e LEFT JOIN catalog.venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id JOIN platform.promoters p ON p.id = e.promoter_id WHERE e.date_start >= NOW() AND p.status = ? AND e.status = ? ORDER BY e.date_start ASC LIMIT ?
